extends.description: Base ruleset to build on. Only 'default' is built in; anything else is read as a path.

allow.description: Terms that never trigger a finding, even if a rule matches them. Treated as regexes.

exclude.description: Glob patterns for files the linter skips entirely.

failOn.description: Severity threshold at which the exit code turns non-zero and the editor hook refuses a write. The default is advisory.

readability.description: Rules measured over sentence structure rather than matched at a point.

kind.description: Required on a new rule. Omit only when the entry overrides an inherited one.

maxWords.description: long-sentence only: the word count above which the rule fires.

known.description: unglossed-term only: names a reader already has. A project's entries add to the defaults rather than replacing them. Distinct from `allow`, which suppresses every rule on a matching line.

structures.description: Sentence shapes no regex can reach. Consumed by the semantic layer and the docs generator.

match.description: Regex applied case-insensitively to the masked text. Required unless the entry only overrides severity.

unless.description: Regexes that cancel a match. Checked against the surrounding line.

message.description: The rewrite hint shown with the finding.

perThousandWords.description: Makes this a rate rule: reported once per file, and only when the measured rate exceeds this threshold.

link.description: Where the finding sends the reader for the reasoning behind the rule.

reason.description: Why this project changed the rule. Set in a project config, never in the shipped ruleset. Printed next to the change in the generated policy document.
